page.overview:
Who is Snow Storm?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Snow Storm was introduced to the A Real American Hero toys as figure #12 in the Battle Corps. ---- Appearance: brown hair; white helmet with clear face shield; white shirt with orange chest armor and gloves; white pants with orange belt and thick boots

Accessories: white "Shockwave" pistol; white "Hit & Run" submachine gun; white "Bullhorn" machine gun; white "Hit & Run" knife; reddish brown "Cross-Country" spring-loaded missile launcher with white trigger; two white "Bazooka" missiles; white figure stand. ---- [http://www.yojoe.com/action/93/snowstorm.shtml YoJoe.com page]/[http://www.yojoe.com/filecard/93/snowstorm.shtml Filecard]
